title: revoked-keys.v1: the signed list of revoked developer keys ('csl-revoked-keys/1')
description: DRAFT: revocation's details are an open question, and the lane that owns signing supplies the fields and the fixtures. The minimum is here. A list names the developer keys that are revoked. An install applies a list only when it is signed by a list key that install trusts. list_version is a whole number that only rises: a list lower than the last one an install accepted is refused, so an old list cannot be replayed to bring a key back. The signature is over the list's canonical bytes without the 'signature' field. NOT DECIDED: what an install does with a list that has expired or cannot be fetched. Until that is answered, the last accepted list stays in force, and the absence of a list never means that nothing is revoked.

key_id.description: The id of the LIST key that signed, not of a developer key.
A public key's stable id: 'ed25519:' and the first 32 hex digits of the key's SHA-256.

timestamp.description: A moment in UTC as RFC 3339 with exactly three decimal places and a 'Z'.
